en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a narrow, old town street with traditional two‑storey houses with overhanging wooden upper floors and tiled roofs. The street is muddy with puddles. A solitary person in dark clothing walks in the foreground. In the background stands a square clock tower with a small cupola on top. At the bottom of the image there is a printed website address indicating archival origin.
